read.en: Corning fell 4.3% on Oct 30 to $123.31, trading between $120.48 and $126.67 on 1.4 times average volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($127.5), 10-day ($128.5), 30-day ($145.5) and 100-day ($161.2) averages and the rising 200-day ($155.7). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12, below zero, histogram narrowing toward a cross; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($133.24), and RSI is 36.
read.zh: 康宁 10月30日下跌 4.3%，收于 $123.31，盘中区间 $120.48–126.67，成交量为均量的 1.4 倍。股价位于下行的 5 日（$127.5）、10 日（$128.5）、30 日（$145.5）和 100 日均线（$161.2）以及上行的 200 日均线（$155.7）下方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图收窄、接近交叉；抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$133.24），RSI 为 36。

read.en: The pullback lost the $128.5–130.3 and $125.4–126.6 supports, now resistance; the low dipped to $120.5 but the close held the $121.8–122.8 lows. Resistance is $125.4–126.7 (Oct 28 low, Oct 30 high), then $127.5–128.6 (5 and 10-day) and $133.2 (SAR). Support is $121.8–122.8, then $120–120.5 (Mar 9 and Oct 30 lows) and $114–114.5. A close above $126.7 would target $128.5; below $120, $114.5.
